status: Explicit absent-platform-signal applicability under E06; hidden recovery is not qualified on Wayland
controlling_clauses: GUI_SHARED_ENGINEERING_CONTRACT E06: platform signals absent on a backend require explicit applicability records.
REC-01: active time excludes zero extent, known occlusion and suspension. Focus loss alone does not establish hidden state.

platform_signal.implementation: Wayland Window::is_minimized returns None. No Occluded emission found in the installed Wayland backend; event-loop frame callback suppression is not an exposed visibility state.

native_observation.compositor: KWin PID/title-filtered temporary script minimizes test window; getWindowInfo independently reports minimized=true, with matching unique caption/resourceClass. Script unloads after operation.
native_observation.fault: Existing opt-in hold-until-retry holds publication of real queue completion after first presentation. No production backend or dependency change.
native_observation.result: No native minimized/occluded event observed. Queue recovery exhausts while KWin still reports minimized. One presentation before/after hidden interval; subsequent native close exits 0 and releases Main ownership.
native_observation.interpretation: Harness detects an unsupported visibility signal and observable limitation; its passed flag is not a product LF-04 pass.
native_observation.failed_attempt: Initial read-side probe expected a PID property absent in getWindowInfo; stopped before minimization and terminated its test process. Corrected lookup uses unique exact caption; mutations still require exact PID/title.

remaining_limits: Wayland minimize/known-occlusion clock-pause qualification unavailable through the existing winit interface. Do not infer pause from no extra presentation or loss of focus.
X11 minimize proof remains separate; zero-size and application suspend rules still apply when delivered. No global LF-04 or S1 acceptance follows.

No specification amendment is needed to describe absent signals: E06 already requires this applicability record. Future signal support remains tracked and cannot introduce or change a dependency without PM029 owner authority.
No renderer code, dependency, backend policy or nonblocking resize exclusion changed.
